title: doctors vision fix
description: A client side true sight mod that reveals visual elements other players cannot see, such as hidden markers, paths, and indicators. Does not affect gameplay for others and works on any server.
body:
🔮 True Sight — Unlock the Hidden Layer of Minecraft 👁️✨

Step beyond normal vision and experience Minecraft in a whole new way with True Sight — a client-side mod that reveals secret visuals, hidden markers, invisible paths, outlines, barriers, clues, and indicators that other players can’t see.
It’s like gaining a personal X-ray of the world, without affecting anyone else’s game. ⚡

True Sight adds a whole extra dimension to your gameplay. Use it to track hidden paths, create private visual markers, reveal custom effects, or highlight things that only you should know about. Whether you're exploring, solving puzzles, planning builds, or designing custom mechanics, this mod becomes your elite perception tool. 🔍🌌

✨ Features

👁️ Shows special client-only visuals invisible to other players

🔒 Works on all servers — even fully vanilla ones

🧭 Great for puzzles, mapmaking, secret bases, and stealth builds

🎯 Zero gameplay impact on anyone else — totally safe and personal

⚡ Lightweight, smooth, and optimized for all systems

🔧 Perfect for modpacks that want magical senses or high-tech overlays

🌟 Why Use True Sight?

Because sometimes you need to see more than what the world shows.
True Sight lets you design secret routes, place personal markers, view hidden clues, and create unique mechanics that stay completely private to you or your players.

Whether you're a builder, adventurer, map creator, or just love immersive tools, True Sight adds the missing sense Minecraft never had.

See the unseen. Reveal the hidden. Experience True Sight. 🔮👁️
